## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta14

### Dialog polish before stable
- Make the Map Card **Settings** dialog close when the user clicks the dimmed backdrop outside the dialog, matching Notifications behavior.
- Make the **Navimower Schedule** dialog close the same way when its backdrop is clicked.
- Move the Navimower Schedule close button to the true top-right of the dialog header. The title/status block now expands independently instead of leaving the close button between the title and scheduler state.
- Keep clicks inside either dialog from closing it accidentally; backdrop close is accepted only when the backdrop itself is the click target.
- Keep the existing dashboard sizing contract unchanged: full-width grid preference with automatic height and no fixed row count.
- Add regression coverage for dialog close behavior, Schedule header alignment and the existing grid sizing defaults.
